# std.worker

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Worker restart policies, and running work under one (let it crash: a
failure restarts the work, within a budget).

## Types

### `Options`

```lang
pub type Options = { max_restarts: Int, window: Duration, backoff: Duration }
```

### `Policy`

```lang
enum Policy { never, on_failure(max_restarts: Int, window: Duration, backoff: Duration) }
```

Restart policy of a managed worker.

### `Shutdown`

```lang
enum Shutdown { cancel, drain(timeout: Duration) }
```

What halting the owning node does with a managed worker.

### `supervise`

```lang
fn supervise<E>(name: Symbol, factory: fn() -> Result<Unit, E>, policy: Policy) -> Unit where E: prelude.Error
```

Run `factory` as a worker under `policy`, in a fresh task each time: it
ends when the work returns `ok` or is cancelled; a failure (an error or
a defect) restarts it within the policy's budget (after its backoff),
and past the budget, or under `never`, fails the caller. Usable in any
task (systems run their workers this way).
